units.source_text: 藏人少将到了中将室中，便向她申恨诉怨，悲叹不已。

en.t: The Chamberlain Lieutenant went to the Chujo's room, poured out his resentment and complaints to her, and lamented without end.

units.source_text: 这个当传言人的中将看他可怜，觉得不宜和他多开玩笑，便含糊其辞，不作分明答语。

en.t: The Chujo, who was acting as messenger, took pity on him and felt it would be wrong to tease him too much, so she spoke vaguely and gave no clear answer.

units.source_text: 藏人少将谈起那天傍晚偷窥赛棋之事，说道：

en.t: The Chamberlain Lieutenant brought up how he had secretly watched the game of go that evening, and said:

units.source_text: “我总想再见一次，像那天傍晚做梦一般隐约也好。

en.t: I keep longing to see her once more, even if only as faintly as in a dream, as I did that evening.

units.source_text: 哎呀！

en.t: Ah!

units.source_text: 教我今后如何活下去呢？

en.t: How am I supposed to go on living from now on?

units.source_text: 和你如此谈话的机会，所余也无多了！

en.t: There are not many chances left for me to speak with you like this.

units.source_text: ‘可哀之事亦可爱’，这句话真有道理！”

en.t: The saying that what is pitiable is also lovable is truly right.

units.source_text: 他说时态度十分认真。

en.t: As he spoke, his manner was utterly earnest.

units.source_text: 中将觉得怪可怜的，然而无法安慰。

en.t: The Chujo felt very sorry for him, but she had no way to comfort him.

units.source_text: 夫人想把二女公子许配他，以慰其情，他却丝毫不感兴趣。

en.t: The lady wished to marry the second young lady to him in order to console his feelings, but he showed not the slightest interest.

units.source_text: 中将推想他那天傍晚分明看到了大女公子的姿态，因此恋慕之心如此热烈，觉得这也是难怪的。

en.t: The Chujo guessed that he had clearly seen the elder young lady's figure that evening, and felt it was no wonder his longing for her burned so intensely.

units.source_text: 但她反过来埋怨他：

en.t: But instead she turned the blame back on him:

units.source_text: “你偷窥的事倘叫夫人知道，她一定怪你不成体统而更加疏远你。

en.t: If the lady were to learn that you peeped in secret, she would certainly fault you for your impropriety and keep you even farther away.

units.source_text: 我对你的同情也消失了。

en.t: My sympathy for you has disappeared as well.

units.source_text: 你这个人真是不可信任啊。”

en.t: You really are someone who cannot be trusted.

units.source_text: 藏人少将答道：

en.t: The Chamberlain Lieutenant replied:

units.source_text: “好，一切听便吧！

en.t: Very well, do whatever you like.

units.source_text: 我命已经有限，什么都不怕了。

en.t: My life is already near its end, so I fear nothing anymore.

units.source_text: 只是那天大女公子赌输了，实甚遗憾。

en.t: It is only that I deeply regret that the elder young lady lost the wager that day.

units.source_text: 那时你何不想个巧妙法儿，把我带了进去？

en.t: Why did you not think of some clever way to bring me inside then?

units.source_text: 我只要使个眼色，包管她一定得胜呢。

en.t: If I had merely given her a glance, I guarantee she would certainly have won.

units.source_text: ”遂吟诗云：

en.t: Then he recited a poem:
